questions.text: Stakeholder-Specific Explainability: Describe explainability mechanisms for different stakeholder groups: End-user explanations; Operator explanations; Technical explanations; Regulatory explanations; Testing results.
questions.evidence_required: Explainability documentation, User testing results, Regulatory compliance reports

questions.text: Algorithmic Transparency (for AI/ML Systems): For systems using AI/ML, provide: Training data documentation; Model architecture description; Performance metrics; Explainable AI implementation; Human override mechanisms.
questions.evidence_required: Model cards, Bias assessment reports, XAI implementation docs

questions.text: Decision Auditability: Demonstrate complete decision auditability: Logging comprehensiveness; Audit trail security; Reproducibility testing; Query capabilities; Regulatory compliance reporting.
questions.evidence_required: Audit logs sample, Security audit report, Reproducibility test results

questions.text: Real-Time System Status Transparency: Describe operational visibility mechanisms: Status dashboard availability; Performance metrics transparency; Alert and notification quality; Historical trend analysis; Planned maintenance communication.
questions.evidence_required: Status page URL, Dashboard screenshots, Notification examples

questions.text: Data Flow Transparency: Map and explain complete data flows: Data source identification; Data transformation documentation; Data storage and access; Data sharing disclosures; Data quality indicators.
questions.evidence_required: Data flow diagrams, Data lineage documentation, Sharing agreements

questions.text: Comprehensive Data Inventory: Provide complete data governance documentation: Data inventory; Data classification; Data minimization justification; Retention policies; Cross-border data flow mapping.
questions.evidence_required: Data inventory register, Retention policy, Cross-border transfer impact assessment

questions.text: Privacy & Security Practices: Document privacy and security implementations: Encryption standards; Access control mechanisms; Privacy impact assessments; Security certifications; Data breach incident response protocols.
questions.evidence_required: Encryption specs, PIA reports, ISO/SOC certifications, Incident response plan

questions.text: User Data Rights Implementation: Demonstrate user rights operationalization: Data access mechanisms; Data correction procedures; Data portability; Data deletion capabilities; Response time metrics.
questions.evidence_required: User rights portal demo, DSAR procedure docs, Response time metrics

questions.text: Multi-Level Documentation Assessment: Provide documentation portfolio for evaluation: User guides; Operator manuals; Technical documentation; Training materials; Documentation currency.
questions.evidence_required: Documentation repository access, Sample manuals, Update logs

questions.text: Documentation Effectiveness Testing: Submit evidence of documentation usability: Task completion testing results; Time-on-task metrics; Error rates; User satisfaction scores; Localization quality.
questions.evidence_required: Usability test reports, User feedback surveys

questions.text: Proactive Communication Assessment: Describe communication practices: Planned maintenance notification; System upgrade communication; Performance degradation alerts; Security issue notifications; Policy/pricing change notifications.
questions.evidence_required: Communication policy, Sample notifications, Incident comms logs

questions.text: Two-Way Communication Mechanisms: Detail stakeholder engagement channels: Support responsiveness; Feedback mechanisms; Community engagement; Escalation pathways; Stakeholder influence on roadmap.
questions.evidence_required: Support SLA reports, Feedback portal access, Roadmap contribution logs

questions.text: Crisis Communication Capability: Provide crisis communication track record: Past incidents; Communication frequency during crises; Post-incident reporting; Stakeholder satisfaction with crisis communication.
questions.evidence_required: Crisis comms plan, Post-mortem reports, Stakeholder feedback

scoring_notes: Layer 2 composite formula: Weighted average of sub-dimensions.
